Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1230
Claimant:
Erik Ayers
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2025-01-17
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision; the insured reports the claimant's vehicle crossed into
their lane on a straight road. Claim file opened and assigned for review.
2025-01-23
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
2025-03-08
Photos taken at the scene show the front-end damage on both vehicles, and the damage pattern matches the
described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is noted in our records or the photos.
2025-04-07
Police report obtained; it confirms the claimant was in the vehcile at the scene. No independent witnesses were
identified, so the account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
2025-04-25
Claimant's counsel notified us of representation and requested that all contact go through their office. Initial recorded
statement scheduled.
2025-05-08
Recorded statement taken from the claimant through counsel. Account of the collision is consistent with the first
notice and with what the claimant described at the scene.
2025-06-09
Medical records received reporting a back strain. The reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type, and no
earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records reviewed.
2025-08-05
Treatment followed a usual course of care and tapered as the patient improved. Follow-up notes show steady
progress with no unepxected changes in the treatment plan.
2025-08-17
Claimant's acconut was reviewed again through counsel and remains the same as in every prior conversation,
including the statement and the call with the adjuster. No inconsistencies have been identified.
2025-08-28
File reviewed against photos, police report, policy records, and medical notes. All items are consistent with the
reported loss; file remains open pending final medical summary from treating provider.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
